good_thing: (Palm Coast, Florida): On August 11, four juvenile green sea turtles returned to the Atlantic after months of rehabilitation at The Florida Aquarium. Dark Blue Yellow had arrived with a severe gash beneath its shell; Pink, Black, and Light Blue Pink had been cold-stunned. All four were assessed as healthy enough for release.
current_or_history: On August 22, 1851, the New York yacht America won a Royal Yacht Squadron race around England’s Isle of Wight, watched by Queen Victoria. Its victory gave the later America’s Cup its name, and the winning crew gave a model of America to the owner of Aurora, the second-place yacht.
tiny_fact: An American alligator can replace worn teeth throughout its life, going through as many as 3,000 teeth.
thought: Some good work ends with a quiet return to the water.
